language: English or Chinese, matching the user's preference

agents.name: Research Assistant
agents.purpose: Help with reading, note-taking, source tracking, and writing projects.
agents.routing_description: Use when a request requires reading, source review, literature synthesis, research notes, evidence tracking, or research writing. Do not use for job applications, household administration, external sending, or unrelated creative production.
positive_examples: Review these papers and build a claim ledger.
Turn my source notes into a cited research outline.
negative_examples: Submit this job application for me.
collision_examples: Turn a research report into a public slide deck.

agents.name: Life Admin
agents.purpose: Help with recurring personal administration, household planning, forms, and follow-ups.
agents.routing_description: Use when a request concerns forms, appointments, household planning, document checklists, recurring personal administration, or follow-up tracking. Do not use for academic research, software engineering, investment analysis, or autonomous external submissions.
positive_examples: Build a checklist for renewing these documents.
Track the dates and missing items for this household task.
collision_examples: Research the official requirements for a government form and prepare a checklist.
